name: mysql-mcp-server
description: MCP server for MySQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL with validated SQL, read-only defaults, allowlists, and PII masking.

DB_ENGINE.title: Database engine
DB_ENGINE.description: mysql or postgres. Omit or leave empty to autodetect from DB_PORT.

DB_PASSWORD.title: Password
DB_PASSWORD.description: Database password (stored in Cursor plugin config, not in the repo)

DB_DATABASE.title: Database
DB_DATABASE.description: Default database (MySQL) or database name (PostgreSQL connection)

DB_ACCESS_MODE.title: Access mode
DB_ACCESS_MODE.description: readonly (default) or readwrite for guarded INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE

DB_ALLOWED_DATABASES.title: Allowlist
DB_ALLOWED_DATABASES.description: Comma-separated db/schema names: name, name:ro, or name:rw

DB_PII_COLUMNS.title: Extra PII columns
DB_PII_COLUMNS.description: Comma-separated column names to mask as ***
